scenario.title: Two-generator buy with non-response and service-scope correction
scenario.summary: Three synthetic suppliers compete for the real two-unit 5 kVA generator requirement. The agent must follow up a non-responder and correct a quote that omits the required quarterly maintenance service before award.

realism.notes: Supplier identities, messages, prices, and event timing are synthetic. The two-unit quantity, PHP 150,000 budget, 15-day delivery requirement, one-year warranty, testing/commissioning, and quarterly-maintenance requirement come from the cited real public starting state.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Initially non-responsive; first quote omits the required quarterly maintenance checks.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes PHP 145,000 for two generators, 12-day delivery, one-year warranty, testing/commissioning, and quarterly maintenance checks.
Supplier B quotes PHP 138,000 with 18-day delivery; service and warranty requirements are otherwise met.
Supplier C does not respond during the normal quotation window.
After follow-up, Supplier C quotes PHP 136,000 with 14-day delivery and one-year warranty, but omits the free quarterly maintenance checks.
Supplier C asks whether the quarterly maintenance checks are mandatory in the supplier scope.

details.question: Are the free quarterly maintenance checks mandatory?

events.observation: Supplier C revises to PHP 141,000, keeps 14-day delivery and one-year warranty, and includes testing/commissioning plus the quarterly maintenance checks.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded total price must not exceed the real PHP 150,000 approved budget.
Delivery must satisfy the real 15-calendar-day requirement.
Award must include two generators, one-year warranty, testing/commissioning, and the stated quarterly maintenance service.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's revision satisfies the real price, delivery, quantity, warranty, testing, and maintenance requirements at the lowest feasible price.
Supplier A is also fully feasible but costs more than Supplier C's compliant revision.

failure_conditions: Awarding Supplier B despite its 18-day delivery.
Awarding Supplier C's original quote without quarterly maintenance.
Awarding above the real PHP 150,000 budget.

economic_objective.description: Among feasible active package offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
